title: etale_inverse_image_unit_eventual_equality
statement: theorem etale_inverse_image_unit_eventual_equality {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)] (i : I) (F : Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (U : (D.obj (op i)).Etale) [CompactSpace U.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left] (s t : F.obj.obj (op U)) (hst : ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).unit.app F).hom.app (op U) s = ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).unit.app F).hom.app (op U) t) : ∃ (k : I) (a : i ⟶ k), ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map a.op)).unit.app F).hom.app (op U) s = ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map a.op)).unit.app F).hom.app (op U) t

proof.text: Apply etale_abelian_unit_equal_open to F, U, s and t to obtain the open W. Its criterion converts the assumed equality under the limit unit into whole inverse image of W under the first pullback projection.

Form baseChangeDiagram D U.hom over Over(op i) and baseChangeCone D c U.hom. isLimitBaseChangeCone proves this cone limiting. Its stage schemes are compact because their first projections are affine and U is compact; its transitions are affine by base change. At the identity object j0, pull back W along the first projection f0. The cone first-projection formula converts the hypothesis to whole inverse image of f0 inverse-image W.

Apply Mathlib exists_map_eq_top to this base-changed limiting cone and open f0 inverse-image W. It gives a stage j and arrow into the identity stage. The baseChangeDiagram first-projection formula identifies the resulting equality with pullback.fst U.hom (D.map j.hom) inverse-image W = top.

Return k = j.left.unop and a = j.hom.unop. The reverse agreement-open criterion at this transition yields exactly the required equality of the two original sections under the transition inverse-image unit.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09XM agreement open; Mathlib exists_map_eq_top and proved baseChangeDiagram/baseChangeCone constructions in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineTransitionLimit.

mathlib_searches.results: exists_app_map_eq_map_of_isLimit and related matches concern structure-sheaf sections, not varying arbitrary etale abelian sheaves.
Confirms the abstract criterion used by the parent reduction; it requires eventual equality and does not supply the geometric comparison.

Mathlib only supplies structure-sheaf equality. Local searches find fixed-site or fixed-sheaf section results requiring additional presentations, and zero_eventually depends on the parent colimit theorem, so using it would be circular.
